_comment: Served checkpoints. All four detectors are SwinFusion++ (arch swinfusionpp, swinfusionpp.py: Swin-B + Video Swin-B fused by TLBG-HCA), the thesis's fixed-recipe runs (fixed_v002). For each dataset the seed with the highest validation Youden's J was chosen (ties: lower validation BCE); temperature and threshold are that run's own validation_operating_point_v001.json (temperature scaling + max-Youden threshold on the calibrated probability), fitted before any test video was scored. frame_spacing_s = median per-video frame spacing of the training split (preprocessing_materialization_v001.parquet). The loader also still reads arch video_swin_b (detector.py) and dfd_fcg (dfd_fcg.py) entries.

weights_source._comment: Private Backblaze B2 bucket; workers download each checkpoint at start with a read-only key (B2_KEY_ID / B2_APP_KEY) and verify its SHA-1. These are byte-identical to the local checkpoint files.

policy._comment: Frozen thesis preprocessing policy preprocessing_v001 (configs/preprocessing/policy_v001.yaml, hash 5610fc20...5632). Do not change.

dfd_fcg._comment: DFD-FCG (arch dfd_fcg). landmarks: the 2D-FAN TorchScript file of face_alignment 1.4.1, which the Dockerfile downloads into the image. Clips are 10 frames; each phase is tiled with clip_stride_in_phase. batch_clips_*: clips per pass through the CLIP ViT-L/14 encoder (>=20 GB cards / smaller cards / CPU).

whole_video._comment: Every decoded frame is analysed. Frames are split into k interleaved phases (k = round(frame_spacing_s x fps)) so each 16-frame clip has the trained spacing; each phase is tiled with clip_stride_in_phase. Clips never bridge face gaps longer than max_gap_factor x spacing. Videos above max_frames are subsampled evenly.

inference._comment: Swin clips per GPU batch (>=20 GB cards / smaller cards / CPU), FaceNet batch, pixel budget per face-detection batch, and GPU decoding. gpu_decode is off: torchcodec's CPU decoder is bit-identical to the thesis's PyAV rgb24 frames, while its GPU decoder (NVDEC, or on hosts where NVDEC declines a video its CPU fallback with GPU colour conversion) differs by up to 2/255 and is not safe with the per-scan CUDA streams of detector.ScanGate.

heatmap._comment: Evidence maps (SwinFusion++: Grad-CAM on both encoders' stage-4 features; Video Swin-B: exact final-stage token contributions) for the top_k most suspicious clips (spread over the video) + the least suspicious, oriented toward the verdict, rendered and JPEG-encoded on the GPU. Shown relative to this video: values at or below low_percentile are clear, high_percentile is full strength.
